podcast.body: This teen pop story song only reached number 60 on the Hot 100 in 1983, failing to achieve a significant crossover in America during their first attempt. "For example, in 1983, the duo WAM got no further than number 60 on the Hot 100 with their Teen Pop Story Song Bad Boys."
